description: Search Yelp local businesses by keyword and city/location (e.g. query="coffee", location="Austin, TX") and retrieve Yelp business_id, alias, unrounded star rating, review count, price level, phone, address, and coordinates. Cost: 5 Credits / business returned.

location.description: City, neighborhood, postal code, or address, e.g. "Austin, TX" or "Brooklyn, NY".

query.description: Search keyword or category, e.g. "specialty coffee", "ramen", or "emergency plumber".

name: yelp_search

data.description: Normalized search results containing matching businesses, employers, destinations, or ranked restaurants with ratings and identifiers.

meta.description: Gateway billing and cache telemetry (credits_charged, credits_remaining, cache hit/miss, latency_ms).

title: Search Yelp Local Businesses & Merchant Ratings
